dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/4] MDD recovery rates posttreatment were significantly greater in the CWD-A condition (17 of 44, 39%) than in the LS condition (9 of 47, 19%) (odds ratio [OR] = 2.66, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.03–6.85; likelihood ratio \chi^2[1, N = 91] = 4.27, p = .039). Recovery rates for CD did not differ significantly between the two conditions: 9% (4 of 44) in CWD-A and 17% (8 of 47) in LS (OR 0.49; 95% CI = 0.14–1.75; \chi^2[1, N = 91] = 1.27, p = .259). Interactions with gender were nonsignificant. AND Table 1, 'Duration (wk) current MDD, mean (SD)'
